codes.GOV-MANIFEST-001: Manifest is missing, unreadable or structurally invalid.
codes.GOV-SYNC-001: A managed governance file does not match its pinned SHA-256 digest.
codes.GOV-DIFF-001: The changed-path set or commit history could not be determined safely.
codes.GOV-BOOT-001: A required target-repository file is missing.
codes.GOV-TICKET-001: Implementation changed without one active ticket.
codes.GOV-TICKET-002: More than one active ticket exists.
codes.GOV-TICKET-003: An active ticket is malformed or missing a required governance file.
codes.GOV-TICKET-004: Executable source, test or research content is stored in a ticket directory.
codes.GOV-TICKET-005: Implementation paths do not resolve to exactly one active ticket.
codes.GOV-STATUS-001: A ticket status is missing or not declared by the governance manifest.
codes.GOV-INTENT-001: Implementation changed before the ticket entered an implementation state.
codes.GOV-INTENT-002: Ticket intent is missing or malformed.
codes.GOV-INTENT-003: Ticket intent was not committed before the first implementation commit.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-001: Implementation lacks approval from a trusted external source.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-002: Approval refers to a different ticket.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-003: Approval evidence is missing, repository-controlled or structurally invalid.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-004: Approval evidence is bound to another repository, pull request or commit.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-005: Approval actor or verification method is not trusted for the claimed source.
codes.GOV-SCOPE-001: A changed implementation path is outside the approved intent scope.
codes.GOV-WORKSTREAM-001: An active v2 ticket declares a missing or unknown workstream.
codes.GOV-WORKSTREAM-002: A workstream exceeds its active-ticket limit.
codes.GOV-WORKSTREAM-003: A changed path is not owned by the ticket workstream.
codes.GOV-WORKSTREAM-004: Active ticket write scopes overlap on a concrete repository path.
codes.GOV-DEPENDENCY-001: The ticket dependency graph contains a cycle or invalid self-reference.
codes.GOV-DEPENDENCY-002: An active ticket depends on a ticket that is missing or not closed.
codes.GOV-CONFLICT-001: Tickets declared as conflicting are active at the same time.
codes.GOV-INTEGRATION-001: A shared contract path lacks valid routing through an integration ticket.
codes.GOV-DELIVERY-001: The implementation slice lacks or exceeds its approved <=30-minute delivery contract.
codes.GOV-DELIVERY-002: The implementation slice reached its pre-stop checkpoint.
codes.GOV-ARCHITECTURE-001: Architecture ownership, UI/data impact or component mapping is unresolved.
codes.GOV-BASE-001: The target branch or base SHA differs from the approved delivery contract.
codes.GOV-BUDGET-001: The actual implementation diff exceeds its approved file, component, interface or dependency budget.
codes.GOV-OWNER-001: An untrusted actor changed a human-owned participant file.
codes.GOV-DOCKER-001: The required Docker runtime declaration is incomplete.
codes.GOV-STACK-001: The declared technology stack lacks its required project marker.
codes.GOV-SECRET-001: A changed file contains a probable secret assignment.
codes.GOV-PATH-001: A committed governance artifact contains a machine-local absolute path.
codes.GOV-DECISION-001: An autonomous decision that changes repository state lacks an append-only decision record, or an earlier record was rewritten.
codes.GOV-DECISION-002: A decision record is not recomputable: inputs are summaries or the applied rule cannot be replayed.
codes.GOV-DECISION-003: A decision record treats ADVISORY LLM output as the verdict authority.
codes.GOV-DECISION-004: Replaying INPUT against APPLIED_RULE diverges from the recorded VERDICT.
